chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
None of you should let the hair of his armpits grow long, for the devil takes it as a shield and hides behind it.

key_terms.رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.مِجَنًّا: a shield; something used as cover

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say about letting underarm hair grow long?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers not to let underarm hair grow long, presenting bodily cleanliness as part of proper conduct. It reflects Prophetic guidance on personal hygiene and refinement, and warns against neglect through vivid moral imagery.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.265 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
'None of you should allow the hair under his armpits to grow long, for the devil takes it as a shield to hide behind.'
